title.narrative: aBi Finance- Financial Inclusion for the Agriculture Sector in Uganda

description.narrative: aBi Finance promotes investments directly by providing credit lines and guarantees to the agriculture sector through financial intermediaries (FIs), and indirectly by strengthening the capability of these institutions to engage in the agriculture sector. Only FIs who have a strategy to work more with the agriculture sector are admitted as partners, and their capabilities are strengthened both by aBi reducing the risk of engaging in the agriculture sector, whereby the institutions obtain experience with the sector, and by providing training and capacity development on a matching grant basis through the Financial Sector Development.
